_comment: Pinned provenance for the Klaus Dormann 6502 functional test suite. Every address below was derived from the listing at this exact revision (see address_derivation), not carried over from another build.

upstream.revision_subject: fixed shifts not testing zero result and flag when last 1-bit is shifted out
upstream.author: Klaus Dormann

image.role: test image loaded verbatim into the 64KB address space

source.role: corresponding assembler source for the image

listing.role: assembler listing; NOT vendored (728KB) but checksummed so the addresses below can be re-derived

image._load_note: The image is a full 64KB memory image: byte i belongs at address $i. There is no header and no relocation.
image._success_note: Success is the self-loop 'JMP $3469' (4C 69 34) emitted by the success macro. Every failure trap is likewise a self-loop, so a stopped PC alone means nothing; only a self-loop at $3469 is a pass.
image._reset_note: The image sets $FFFC to res_trap ($37A3), a failure trap. The runner must set PC = $0400 directly and must NOT vector through reset, which is what the upstream source instructs ("alter PC to 400 hex (code_segment) and enter a go command").

irq_trap._note: BRK/IRQ handler; not a bare self-loop

assembly_configuration._comment: Equates as assembled at this revision; they fix the memory layout and what is tested.
assembly_configuration._report_note: report = 0 selects the self-trap loops, so the suite needs no I/O channel and no host hooks.
assembly_configuration._decimal_note: disable_decimal = 0, so decimal ADC/SBC are exercised, but only with valid BCD operands and with N, V and Z ignored. NMOS decimal flag behaviour is therefore NOT covered here.
assembly_configuration._selfmod_note: disable_selfmod = 0, so parts of the image modify themselves and the whole image must be writable RAM.

memory_requirements._comment: Regions the suite reads, writes or executes. The runner loads the whole image, so these are documentation.
memory_requirements.stack: $0100-$01FF (the suite invalidates the stack during the run)

address_derivation._comment: Where each address above comes from in the pinned listing, so a future reader can re-check it.
address_derivation.entry_address: listing line 740: "0400 : d8   start   cld" (org code_segment, line 739)
address_derivation.success_address: listing line 13377: "3469 : 4c6934 >  jmp *   ;test passed, no errors"
address_derivation.vectors: listing lines 14349-14351: dw nmi_trap ($379D), res_trap ($37A3), irq_trap ($37AB) at org $FFFA
address_derivation.cross_check: The vendored .bin was read at each of these addresses and matches the listing bytes exactly, which confirms the image and the listing are the same build.

coverage_limits: Documented NMOS opcodes only; no undocumented/illegal opcodes.
Decimal ADC/SBC: valid BCD operands only, with N, V and Z ignored.
No external interrupt behaviour (that is the separate 6502_interrupt_test, which needs a feedback register).
No instruction timing or cycle accuracy: the suite checks results and flags, not cycles.
No AMICO 2000 hardware: no monitor ROM, no 8255 PIA, no display, no keyboard, no cassette.
